name: distorted-glass

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows the warm sunset smeared through the glass strip at the bottom most clearly.

tagline: A frosted, rippled glass band sits across the bottom edge.
summary: A short strip of frosted glass with a rippled surface, pinned over the bottom of a scrolling image feed. It warps and blurs whatever passes underneath and lets scrolling pass through.
appearance: A narrow band along the bottom of a photo card looks like rippled frosted glass, smearing the image behind it into soft waves and glowing where the photo is warm. Above it, sharp stacked photos carry white captions.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves on its own. Whatever scrolls behind the strip is bent by the glass, and the strip ignores the pointer so the feed keeps scrolling under it.
demo_content: A scrolling set of travel photos: Above the clouds, Golden hour ridge, Facade study, Fire in the sky.
search_phrases: rippled glass edge on a scrolling feed
blurred distortion at the bottom of a card
water ripple effect over a photo
frosted bottom bar for a feed
rippled glass panel over a gallery
use_when: A scrolling gallery needs a soft frosted fade at its bottom edge so images dissolve into the frame.
avoid_when: Small copy must stay legible behind it: the glass blurs and warps whatever sits underneath.
customise: Only className is accepted; the ripple frequency, displacement scale and glass gradient are fixed in the SVG filter and style block.
weight_why: One static SVG turbulence filter and a repeating gradient; no animation loop.

a11y.note: The strip is decorative and lets the pointer through, but it stays hidden below the xl breakpoint, so smaller screens lose it.

issues: The glass strip is hidden below the xl breakpoint, so it disappears on smaller screens.
The filtered SVG is not marked aria-hidden, so assistive tech may announce a stray Distorted Glass image.
polish_why: Convincing frosted ripple over photos; it is tiny at the bottom and vanishes on small screens.
title: Distorted Glass
